summary_en: 150,000 shares (1.56% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 26 Aug 2026 at ¥2,955/share (closing price 25 Aug 2026), up to ¥443.25M aggregate. Order valid for single trading window only.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares through off-exchange buyback transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 25 August 2026, Taiko Bank's Board resolved to acquire up to 150,000 treasury shares via off-exchange ToSTNeT-3 transaction on 26 August 2026 morning, using the closing price of 2,955 yen/share from 25 August as the purchase price. The aggregate acquisition limit is 443.25 million yen. The buyback order will be valid only during the designated trading window; no modifications or alternative execution methods are planned. Acquisition results will be announced after the 26 August trading session closes. The bank stated the buyback aims to enable flexible capital policy execution and enhanced shareholder returns. As of 31 July 2026, the bank held 40,949 treasury shares against 9,630,451 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
